text:
incident-bot: ALERT: elevated 5xx rates observed in prefix-cache layer across us-east-1 -> paging on-call :rotating_light:

sre-oncall: on it. I'm seeing a spike in 502/504 from gateway logs starting ~2250123400. Customers reporting timeouts.

maria: confirming metrics — prefix cache miss rate up 8x, eviction rate spiked. heatmap shows a small set of prefixes thrashing.

lee: logs show repeated cache-load errors: `kv-get: corrupt-index` on a subset of shards. Might be partial index corruption causing missstorms.

anita: any customer-facing impact? CS reports several enterprise jobs failing with 5xx, specifically batch embed requests. Jordan, any customer alerts?

jordan: one SOC has reported timeouts to their ML pipeline, they're seeing retries and rate-limit alarms. No major data loss but high latency.

andrew: quick mitigation plan: (1) route traffic off affected prefix-shards to fallback routing (2) disable prefetcher/auto-evict for those shards (3) enable read-through bypass to origin for corrupted keys.

sre-oncall: agree. I'm going to add a temporary routing rule to push ~20% traffic to fallback model farm, then ramp if stable.

incident-bot: @sre-oncall acknowledged paging. Incident channel created. Runbook: KV-Prefix-Corruption -> start live-handoff.

maria: steps I'm running now: `curl -XPOST /admin/shard/mark-readonly -d shard=shard-47` then `echo 'disable-prefetch' > /proc/prefetch/control` on shard nodes.

lee: i'm tailing the node logs. Seeing repeated `IndexChecksumMismatch` during compaction on shard-47 and shard-51. Could be bad disk pages after compaction job.

andrew: can we quick-replicate shards from healthy replicas? If we can promote a good replica we avoid full rebuild.

sre-oncall: spinning promotion for shard-51 to replica-2 now.

ops-bot: Deploy job queued: `promote-replica --shard=shard-51 --target=replica-2` (job id: 89321).

anita: adding customer impact note: Affected customers: cust-42 (batch embeddings), cust-77 (realtime chat enrichment). Both on us-east-1. Severity: degraded but not complete outage.

jordan: notifying account reps: sending templated update: "We're investigating increased 5xx/timeouts in us-east-1 affecting prefix cache. Short-term mitigations in progress; we'll provide ETA in 30m."

lee: promoted replica completed for shard-51. Monitoring. Early signs: decreased `IndexChecksumMismatch` logs on promoted node.

maria: disabled auto-evict on shard-47/51 and increased TTL for relevant prefix keys: `SET prefix.ttl=600` to reduce churn.

andrew: enabling bypass for problematic prefixes so requests go directly to origin model host when cache returns 5xx. Patch applied: `routing.rules.add(bypass_on_5xx=True, prefixes=[/user/*/embed])`

sre-oncall: rolling routing change to 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 5m. Observability dashboard pinned.

incident-bot: Change: routing rules updated (10% fallback) by sre-oncall at 2250123600.

anita: Posting interim customer update to status page and to affected accounts.

jordan: Cust-42 confirms reduced errors after fallback applied; their retry rate dropped ~40%.

lee: still seeing some corruption traces on shard-47 compactor; planning controlled restart of compactor process on nodes with degraded checksums.

maria: note: compactor restart will briefly increase CPU and IO; scheduling one node at a time.

andrew: starting controlled restart on shard-47-node-a. `systemctl restart compactor --no-block` logged.

ops-bot: Node restart completed for shard-47-node-a. Health: green.

lee: compactor logs look healthy now, checksum errors not appearing on node-a. Monitoring for node-b/c.

sre-oncall: increasing fallback to 75% while we finish rebuild. 5xx rate has dropped 73% since mitigations.

anita: customer impact update: now marked as "degraded" on status; escalation call not needed. Reps notified.

jordan: customers asked for ETA for full remediation — estimate 2-4 hours for shard rebuild and validation.

maria: kicked off background shard heal for shard-47-node-b node-c: `kv-shard-heal --shard=47 --from=replica-healthy` job 89345.

lee: one weirdness: a small percent of keys still returning `kv-metadata-mismatch` after heal; adding a small repair job that rewrites manifests.

andrew: once repairs complete we can remove bypass and set TTLs back to normal. Also recommend postmortem: look into compactor rolling window and disk-health checks to prevent silent corruption.

sre-oncall: handoff to night oncall @andrew in 30m. Current state: degraded, customer impact reduced, mitigation in place (fallback routing + bypass + TTL increase + shard promotions). Tracking: recreate keys repair + shard heal ongoing. If anyone sees spike > 10% 5xx reactivate paging.

andrew: ack. I will own final verification and rollback plan. Leaving notes in incident runbook section.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATED: status=mitigated, impact=degraded, owners=[sre-oncall,andrew], started=2250123456, updated=2250123800.

anita: postmortem checklist: contact CS for customer post-incident comms, collect logs/heap profiles, reproduce compactor failure in staging, validate shard repair tool.

maria: saving diagnostics bundle: `/var/logs/kv/shard-47/diag-2250123800.tar.gz` and attaching to pager duty case.

jordan: sharing summary to execs and account teams. Great work team. :clap:

sre-oncall: closing thread for now, will reopen if regressions. Good handoff to @andrew.

andrew: will follow up with a quick triage doc and schedule postmortem meeting tomorrow.
